latest.title: Can Humans Speed Up the Return of Christ?
latest.desc:
Can humans actually speed up the return of Christ? In this Hot Question, Shawn Ryan sits down with Bryce Crawford to break down what the Bible really says about the end times, the Second Coming, and whether the war with Iran is a sign of biblical prophecy unfolding in real time.
